title: Qualify the exact ordinary-Pro-Chat read path
setup: Record account/workspace, visible selected model/effort, browser, plugin version, transport, server commit, and catalog hash.
steps: Select PatchBay on this message.
Read a known immutable fixture file.
Correlate the visible call with authenticated server ingress and exact source digest.
pass_condition: The intended ordinary Chat surface actually reaches the intended Linux service and returns the expected revision; unknown fields remain unknown.
safety_boundary: Use disposable repositories, identities, tasks, and endpoints. No production effects or paid worker invocation without separate authorization.

title: Qualify a permitted mutation, not merely a visible schema
setup: An operator explicitly authorizes one harmless canary mutation in a disposable task.

Execute the canary through ordinary Chat, including any real approval interaction.
Read back the durable receipt and actual effect.
pass_condition: Exactly the authorized effect occurs or a truthful capability denial is recorded; visibility alone is not treated as permission.
safety_boundary: Use disposable repositories, identities, tasks, and endpoints. No production effects or paid worker invocation without separate authorization.
